slug.description: The app's short name, unique among the apps mounted on one agents server. It names the mount, the tool documents it projects and the secrets that belong to it.

summary.description: One sentence on what the app does, shown in the Apps dialog and in the model's Space index.

type.description: The kind of value the argument takes.

secret.description: A secret argument (an API key, a token) is never written into a document. The person mounting the app stores it on the agents server, where it is encrypted and paired with the mount.

required.description: A mount without this argument offers no tools until it is provided.

order.description: Where the argument sits in the mount form, lowest first.

description.description: What the argument is for, shown beside its field.

choices.description: The allowed values, keyed by value with a label for each, when the argument is a choice.

arguments.description: The arguments a mount of this app takes, keyed by argument name. Each entry says what the argument is, whether it is secret and whether it is required.

permissions.description: Grants the app's tools need beyond being called, as flags keyed by grant name, such as `publish`. A set of flags is a map because a document's attributes hold scalars and nested maps.

network.description: The hosts the app's code may reach, keyed by a label because map keys cannot contain dots: `{datalab: www.datalab.to}`. The sandbox lets the code reach exactly these hosts and nothing else, and an app that declares none runs without network. Shown to the person mounting the app.

meter.description: Whether the server counts what the app consumes. `per-unit` means a server-wide mount is metered per space and the Apps dialog shows what is used and what is left.

period.description: How often the count starts over.

callCap.description: The most units one call may consume. On a metered mount the server reserves up to this many before the run and tells the tool its budget.

usage.description: How the app's consumption is counted and shown, so a server can offer the app on a shared key with a monthly allowance and tell people where they stand. The allowance itself is set on the server-wide mount.

scope.description: `space` mounts the app for the space the bundle is published in. `server` mounts it for every space on the agents server, and is honored only in the server operator's space.

enabled.description: A disabled mount keeps its arguments but offers no tools.

arguments.description: Values for the bundle's non-secret arguments, keyed by argument name.

mount.description: Set when the app page is published into a space to be mounted there, the copy form of a mount. An app published as a library entry leaves it unset, and spaces mount it through an app-mount document instead.

description: A Seed Agents app: the home page of an app, whose attributes declare its name, the arguments a mount takes, the grants it needs, the hosts its code reaches and how its usage is counted, and whose body is the skill doc the model reads. Its `tools` folder holds one app-tool document per tool, each carrying its own code.
